jobs.title: Mid .NET Full Stack Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is hiring a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack) to join our technology team in Warsaw!

As a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack), you’ll work closely with product managers, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to design and develop complex solutions that deliver real value to our customers. Your expertise in .NET, databases, and distributed systems will be key as you optimize and modernize code for performance, scalability, and reliability. You’ll join a highly collaborative Book Team focused on the shipment-booking domain, including carrier offers, shipments available to book, pricing guidance, and the services that enable carrier booking. This is a full-stack role with a strong focus on backend, database, and middle-tier engineering.

At C.H. Robinson, we support a healthy work-life balance through flexible work arrangements. This role is based in Poland, with a preference for candidates in Warsaw or within reasonable commuting distance. The team may meet in the Warsaw office periodically for collaboration, while day-to-day work can be performed flexibly based on what works best for you and the team.

Join us in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership of meaningful projects, collaborate across our global technology organization, and help modernize critical systems that support how freight is booked!

*RESPONSIBILITIES*

Define interfaces, develop solutions, and influence architectural changes in partnership with principal engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.
Optimize, refactor, modernize, and reuse code for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Research complex problems, translate high-level requirements into technical designs, and break smaller projects into deliverable work.
Increase code quality through code reviews, automated testing, and sound engineering practices.
Proactively troubleshoot and resolve production issues across distributed systems.
Implement secure programming patterns and enhance application security.
Estimate project needs and dependencies, communicate progress, and drive work through to completion.
Collaborate actively with engineers across Poland and the United States, sharing opinions, feedback, and technical knowledge.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools for coding, research, and design while applying independent judgement and validating the quality of the output.

*QUALIFICATIONS*

Required

3+ years of experience working in a software development team environment
3+ years of experience creating applications and features in an object-oriented environment (e.g., C#, .NET)
Experience working with relational databases and SQL, including database objects, queries, and data-focused application development
Experience designing or developing microservices, APIs, or distributed systems (e.g., WebAPI, ServiceStack, REST APIs)
Experience with Kubernetes or containerized application environments
Experience with code reviews, code optimization, unit testing, acceptance testing, and version control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, TFS)
Experience independently researching and designing a small project, breaking down the work, and driving it through to completion
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including sharing opinions, giving feedback, and communicating timelines and project progress
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, with the ability to critically review and validate the output
Fluent English

Preferred

Experience with data streaming architecture and frameworks (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, ESB)
Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines
Experience with system integration, global projects, or large-scale distributed systems
Experience with transportation, logistics, booking, pricing, or other business-critical systems

*WHAT WE OFFER*

A fun, open, and inclusive workplace that encourages innovative thinking
Opportunities for professional growth with access to training platforms
Flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance
Full-time employment contracts (umowa o pracę - UoP)
Comprehensive benefits: competitive salary and performance-based bonuses, private medical care, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) after one year of employment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

*Compensation Range*

zł174,500.00 - zł373,300.00

The base pay range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for the position across the entirety of the country this requisition is posted in. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only.

Questioning if you meet the mark? Studies have shown that some individuals may be less likely to apply unless they match the job description exactly. Here at C.H. Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (C# / Angular) | Poland
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

We are currently looking for experienced Senior Creatio CRM Developers to join our technology leadership team.

If you enjoy solving complex business and technical challenges, designing scalable enterprise solutions, and helping other developers grow, we would like to meet you.

Previous Creatio experience is highly valued; however, experienced Senior Software Engineers from CRM, BPM, or enterprise application backgrounds who are willing to learn the platform are also encouraged to apply.

You will work on strategic digital transformation initiatives and help shape technical delivery standards across our growing Creatio practice.

Requirements:

Advanced knowledge of C# and .NET Framework/.NET Core

Strong software engineering and system integration experience
Excellent knowledge of JavaScript / Angular

Experience designing scalable enterprise applications
Strong SQL and database design skills
Extensive experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Experience with OData services and enterprise integrations
Strong understanding of Git workflows and branching strategies
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and release management
Strong knowledge of design patterns, architecture principles, and clean code practices
Experience conducting code reviews and technical mentoring
Experience leading technical workstreams or development teams
Ability to contribute to project estimation and solution design
Strong stakeholder communication skills
Willingness to obtain Creatio certifications within the first year if not already certified
Communicating in English at a B2 level or higher
EU citizenship or valid work permit to work in Poland is required

Your future role

Lead development streams within complex Creatio implementations
Drive technical quality and development best practices across projects
Work closely with Solution Architects and Technical Architects on solution design
Design scalable, maintainable, and secure CRM and BPM solutions
Develop advanced customizations using C#, JavaScript, Freedom UI, and platform capabilities
Review technical solutions and code produced by project teams
Mentor Mid-Level and Junior Developers
Define implementation approaches, integration patterns, and development standards
Support estimations, proposal preparation, and pre-sales activities
Collaborate directly with client technical teams and stakeholders
Contribute to internal accelerators, reusable assets, and innovation initiatives

What we offer

Opportunity to work in the largest Creatio practice in the region
Strategic and enterprise-level projects with international clients
Direct collaboration with Creatio Product Management and platform leadership
Influence over development standards, architecture approaches, and engineering governance
Opportunity to shape the growth of a rapidly expanding Creatio community
Supported certification program and advanced technical training
Defined career path toward Technical Architect, Solution Architect, and Practice Leadership roles
Access to a broad network of technology specialists and business consultants
Participation in innovation initiatives and platform strategy discussions
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
Flexible working model supporting work-life balance
A collaborative culture that values expertise, initiative, and knowledge sharing

Selection process

Application review and HR screening
Technical interview with senior architects
Technical leadership and project discussion
Business interview (optional)
Offer stage

Join us and help shape the future of enterprise CRM and business process automation solutions.

About Deloitte

In Deloitte we support leading global organizations in optimizing and transforming their organizations. This also relates to their finance function. Our consultants offer insights, capabilities, and solutions that change the way these organizations operate and make people-related decisions.

We are currently building in Poland a dedicated team which will focus on advisory in the area of Finance & Performance. The Team will advise our Clients in complex issues relating to i.a. Reporting, Budgeting, Controlling processes. We are looking for high-energy, committed and ambitious people to join our advisory practice. Next to advising on most sophisticated and challenging issues relating to the above mentioned areas, our Consulting professionals will also advise on potential solutions leading to optimisation of the above mentioned processes. This will also include applying the newest technologies.

Are you ready to join our team and help our clients imagine, deliver, and run their future?

About the team

Our Creatio practice delivers enterprise CRM and BPM solutions across Sales, Service, and Process Automation domains.

We are one of the largest and fastest-growing Creatio teams in the region, delivering complex international programs while maintaining a strong engineering culture.

We partner closely with Creatio, participate in platform initiatives, and collaborate directly with product experts to help our clients maximize the value of their investments.

Our team combines architects, consultants, business analysts, developers, DevOps engineers, and delivery leaders who share a passion for innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. This creates an environment where experienced professionals can have real impact while continuing to grow their careers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
We are building a new team in Krakow.

Our employees work fully from the office with the possibility to work remotely occasionally.

EBS is a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company and part of Alarm.com. Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6+ million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. We’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more.

Do you enjoy working across diverse products and building cool, impactful features? As a Software Engineer II, you'll have the opportunity to do exactly that. Alarm.com is a leading IoT company, and as part of the Video Team, you'll help drive features that power millions of commercial and residential properties worldwide.

Alarm.com's product ecosystem spans video, automation, access control, energy management, and more. In this role, your work will be centered on the Video domain, designing and delivering robust, scalable software solutions that make homes smarter, safer, and more efficient through intelligent video monitoring. You will have the opportunity to shape how millions of users experience video, enhancing existing capabilities while pushing the boundaries of what intelligent monitoring can do.

Key Responsibilities

Write and maintain high-quality C#/.NET back-end code across the Video domain—including device lifecycle management and device-based features—along with the customer-facing web UIs built on top of it.
Own features end-to-end, taking them from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, testing, release, and production support, and seeking out information and context as needed to deliver good outcomes.
Exercise good judgment. Know when to work quickly, and when to build a robust solution.
Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, both receiving feedback and providing thoughtful, constructive review on peers' work.
Debug and troubleshoot issues across environments, applying reasoning to identify root causes and deliver durable fixes.

AI-Fluent Engineering

Use AI-assisted development tools as a consistent part of your engineering workflow.
Validate AI-generated code rigorously before it reaches production: review for correctness, edge cases, security implications, and long-term maintainability.

Requirements

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent work experience
2+ years of professional software development experience
Strong object-oriented programming skills; professional C#/.NET experience preferred
Experience with a modern front-end framework such as Ember or React
Experience with SQL databases, including DML operations, stored procedures, and writing performant queries through indexing and batching
Experience with creating and maintaining unit tests
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of work end-to-end, from design through delivery

NICE TO HAVES

Familiarity with microservices architecture
Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architecture, or messaging technologies
Experience working with IoT and hardware
Experience with observability, logging, error handling, and monitoring in production systems
Experience integrating AI-assisted development tools into a professional engineering workflow

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

Collaborate with outstanding people: We have a strong focus on teamwork, and we work to create a collaborative and welcoming environment that enables our teams to excel.
Make an immediate impact: You can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You will be empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
Be Empowered: We don't want to micro-manage you. We want you to own stuff and bring your experience to make those products the best in class.
Work with the Latest Technologies: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT and SaaS technologies, including C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, React, Ember, and more. 
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package: including medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we're innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. We're seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

EBS Sp. z o.o. is a dynamically growing Polish technology company, combining decades of innovation with deep expertise in smart security solutions. We are part of the American corporation Alarm.com, a leading global provider of intelligent security solutions for homes and businesses.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com or ebssmart.com

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to, or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations, such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring compliance with labor laws and regulations, even after we have made our employment decision. We will retain this data for a maximum of 3 years after the end of the recruitment process. The data administrator is EBS Sp. z o.o.
